Normalize imported filter params back to their constructed form

Source: R/recipe.R
dot-recipe_restore_params.Rd

JSON parsing (simplifyVector = FALSE) turns atomic vectors into unnamed lists of scalars, and loses the integer/double distinction. This restores atomic vectors and re-applies the canonical storage types used by the omop_filter_* constructors so an export/import round-trip compares identical(). Named lists (e.g. window, value) are kept intact.

Usage

.recipe_restore_params(params)

Arguments

params

Named list of filter parameters.

Value

The normalized parameter list.
